description: a user-changed shortcut (<Super>F9) is what gsettings reports

fired.sh: for schema in org.gnome.desktop.wm.keybindings org.gnome.shell.keybindings org.gnome.mutter.keybindings org.gnome.mutter.wayland.keybindings org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.media-keys; do gsettings list-recursively $schema; done | grep -F "'<Super>F9'"
